description: Simplified Chinese glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the Chinese form used in every file. keep_latin: Latin words the validator accepts in the Chinese text. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Everyone says 你 (no 您): Harry and Cybil, Harry and Lisa, Harry and Kaufmann, Harry and Dahlia. Dahlia speaks in an elevated, half-classical register (岂不正如我所言, 万事皆休, 汝 only in the inscription of the five items); to Alessa she calls herself 妈妈. Alessa and Cheryl: 妈妈, 爸爸. The cult's deity is 祂. The aliens of the UFO ending are addressed as 你们.
style.gender: Chinese verbs carry no gender; third person: 她 for Cheryl, Alessa and the patient, 它 for the demon and the seal, 他们 for 'them' in Lisa's last scene.
style.punctuation: Full-width punctuation (，。！？：；、（）《》), no spaces between words. Quotes “ ” for the [ ] of the English, 《 》 for titles of books and of the piano riddle. The ellipsis is …… (two U+2026), the dash —— (U+2014); the noise of the broken tape is a row of —. Names are joined with · (U+00B7): 哈利·梅森, K·戈登.
style.line_breaks: A full-width character is 12 px: at most 25 per message line, 16 per item name, 22 per description line. Lines break between phrases, never before closing punctuation or after opening punctuation; build_lang.py wraps a draft line without '|' at any character, so a line longer than the box is better broken by hand.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence is the inventory name unchanged: '这里有<name>。要拿走吗？', '使用了<name>。', '得到了<name>。'
style.numbers: Clock times, the door code, dates and counts of the notes stay in digits (10:00, 0886, 8月20日, 6栋); ages and counts in speech are written in characters (七岁, 四年前).

terms.Lion / Woodman / Scarecrow: 狮子 / 铁皮人 / 稻草人
terms.Ophiel / Hagith / Phaleg / Bethor / Arat: 奥菲尔 / 哈吉斯 / 法莱格 / 贝托尔 / 阿拉特隆
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: 手枪 / 猎枪 / 霰弹枪
